repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-avatar
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.avatar that resolves Webex users to avatar URLs. retrieveAvatarUrl(user, options) turns a uuid, email, or user object into a uuid through webex.internal.user.asUUID, answers from an in-memory store keyed by uuid and size, and on a miss requests the asked size plus every configured size (40, 50, 80, 110, 135, 192, 640, 1600; default 80) through a batcher that groups lookups into one POST profiles/urls to the avatar service; entries expire after cacheControl seconds (3600 by default), and hideDefaultAvatar makes a default avatar resolve null. setAvatar(file) resizes the image with @webex/helper-image, uploads it as the current user's avatar through the three-phase webex-core upload to profile sessions of the avatar service, clears that user's cached sizes, and resolves the new URL. Nothing is persisted.

avatar-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-user and @webex/internal-plugin-device, then registers Avatar as internal plugin 'avatar' with the avatar config from src/config.js; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default Avatar class. webex.internal.avatar exposes retrieveAvatarUrl(user, options) and setAvatar(file), the enableThumbnails session property, the store session property, the batcher child, and the underscore-prefixed _fetchAvatarUrl and _fetchAllAvatarUrlSizes; specified in src/docs/README.md.

avatar-http.source: Avatar service (catalog service name avatar, reached through api: 'avatar' in src/avatar-url-batcher.js and src/avatar.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
avatar-http.summary: POST /profiles/urls with body [{uuid, sizes}] answering {<uuid>: {<size>: {size, url, defaultAvatar, cacheControl}}}; POST /profile/<userId>/session answering an upload session {id, url}; PUT to the session url with the image bytes; PUT /profile/<userId>/session/<sessionId> answering the new avatar url.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-008, MOD-013, MOD-044)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerInternalPlugin keys the plugin by its raw name (avatar, first registration wins) and merges its config into the defaults; WebexPlugin supplies webex, children, session properties, namespaced config, logger, request, and upload.

webex-core-batcher.source: @webex/webex-core Batcher (module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-050 to MOD-053; code consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/batcher.js)
webex-core-batcher.summary: Batcher.request de-duplicates by fingerprint, flushes through a capped debounce read from the subclass namespace config (batcherWait, batcherMaxWait, batcherMaxCalls), maps responses back through getDeferredForResponse, and on failure settles every queued deferred.

webex-core-upload.source: @webex/webex-core upload (module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-038 to MOD-042)
webex-core-upload.summary: upload rejects without options.file, runs initialize (POST), upload (PUT, no SDK authorization, retried), and finalize phases, replaces $-prefixed phase keys with functions of the initialize body, and resolves the finalize body merged with its headers.

internal-plugin-user-uuid.source: @webex/internal-plugin-user (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-user/src/docs/README.md MOD-002, MOD-004)
internal-plugin-user-uuid.summary: asUUID(user) rejects a missing user, returns a uuid unchanged, and resolves an email through the user batcher.

internal-plugin-device-identity.summary: Imported by src/index.js for registration. userId is a registration property read from webex.internal.device by setAvatar.

helper-image-processing.source: @webex/helper-image (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/helper-image/src/docs/README.md MOD-002, MOD-007 to MOD-009, MOD-013, MOD-014)
helper-image-processing.summary: detectFileType(file, logger) resolves a MIME type or null; processImage resolves undefined for a non-image or the triple [thumbnail, fileDimensions, thumbnailDimensions], with an empty thumbnail when enableThumbnails is off; the bundler selects a Node (GraphicsMagick) or browser (canvas) implementation, and only the browser one honors isAvatar.

common-one-flight.source: @webex/common (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md; code consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/one-flight.js, src/patterns.js)
common-one-flight.summary: oneFlight keys a flight per instance by method name plus keyFactory(...args) and drops it on settle unless cacheSuccesses or cacheFailures is set; patterns.uuid matches lowercase hex uuids only.

common-timers-safe-timeout.source: @webex/common-timers (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common-timers/src/docs/README.md MOD-001, MOD-002)
common-timers-safe-timeout.summary: safeSetTimeout forwards to setTimeout and unrefs the handle where the platform supports it, so store expiry timers do not keep a Node process alive.
